title: hotfix: tighten SLO enforcer thresholds and stability for regional failover
author: Aisha Kumar
description: Hotfix for the SLO enforcer that caused aggressive regional failovers during sustained transient errors. Root cause: threshold smoothing and backoff interacted poorly with short-lived latency spikes, causing the enforcer to trip early and trigger regional failover cascades. This change tightens thresholds, adds per-region hysteresis, improves ordering of fallback candidates, and adds extra telemetry to make regressions visible. Includes unit and integration tests and an emergency rollforward plan. Checklist: [x] reproduce issue in integration harness, [x] add unit tests for smoothing window boundary, [x] add hysteresis config and default sane values, [x] update fallback ordering to prefer less-loaded region, [x] add metric labels and dashboard links, [x] run full CI and canary. Related: linear/ENG-2345. Motivation: reduce unnecessary failovers during transient networking glitches while preserving SLO protection under real overloads.
commits: fix(slo-enforcer): tighten threshold smoothing and add hysteresis defaults
chore(test): add regional_failover_integration and boundary unit tests
fix(slo-enforcer): prefer fallback candidates by active_capacity then latency
docs: document new hysteresis config and rollout guidance
files_changed: services/slo-enforcer/src/enforcer/thresholds.rs - adjust smoothing window and add hysteresis logic
services/slo-enforcer/src/enforcer/fallback.rs - change fallback ordering and add safeguards
review_comments: Marco Li (review): Found a potential race in quorum count when regions report delayed metrics; requested a guard and an extra unit test.
Aisha Kumar (author): Added guarded quorum check and unit test for delayed-report scenario; explained rationale for changing fallback ordering to prefer active_capacity over recent latency spikes.
Sofia Reyes (review): Asked for telemetry labels to help diagnose future incidents; requested dashboard link. Aisha updated metrics and added dashboard panels.

Daniel Chen (review): Noted flaky integration test on first CI run (regional_failover_integration) and asked to stabilize before merge. CI rerun passed after adding a retry and tightening timing assertions.
release_notes: Hotfix: SLO enforcer thresholds tightened and per-region hysteresis added to prevent unnecessary regional failovers during transient spikes. Improved fallback ordering to favor regions with active capacity. Adds integration test and telemetry. No breaking changes for customers; rollout to prod via canary and forced backout plan included.
body_summary: Emergency fix to reduce spurious regional failovers by adjusting smoothing, adding hysteresis, and improving fallback ordering; includes tests, telemetry, and docs.
